content.subject: Congrats on the new role, Devin
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. I'm reaching out because month-end close reconciliation may be an area we could help with.

I read your announcement about becoming ShipMonk's CFO, especially your note about being thrilled to join the team. I imagine keeping month-end close records aligned across systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We extract transaction data from source systems, match it against ledger entries, and generate reconciliation reports, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
